summary: Expanded the underfollowed lane around scarce or hard-to-switch private-label/value-tier consumer staples supply. The strongest public-company fits found in this pass are not broad branded CPG leaders, but processors and input suppliers with category-specific plants, customer-label capability, retailer/customer concentration, food-safety or product qualification friction, or raw-material/capacity exposure.
